answer: An attacker forging a thousand identities pays a thousandfold in energy, far above honest single-agent cost. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work reputation slot: each agent must burn compute to mint a unique key, with difficulty scaling so mass registration costs grow quadratically. Reputation then compounds like pigment deepening a nebula's hue, and honest nodes rise to the network's zenith while cheap fakes stall at low trust. This makes swarms economically irrational. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
